blocks.text: Genesis 29 brings Jacob to Haran and Rachel at the well. Jacob serves Laban seven years for Rachel, but Laban gives him Leah first; Jacob then receives Rachel after another agreement and serves further years. Jehovah sees Leah’s lack of love and gives her children, while Rachel remains barren in this chapter. The births of Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah shape the household conflict.
